title: Hydrogen storage in activated carbon materials: Role of the nanoporous texture
material_description: Carbon C | activated carbon in development (origin not stated)
source_location: main-3 (p. 2746), Table 1, row 'Carbon C', column 'H2 adsorption capacity (wt%) 1 bar'
notes: Table 1 header "H2 adsorption capacity (wt%)"; 77 K; pressures printed as "1 bar", "3 bar", "7 bar", "10 bar" (absolute or gauge not stated, stored as printed). Method (main-2 text): 1.5 g carbon loaded in a cell, "carefully heat treated under vacuum" (no degas temperature or duration), immersed in liquid N2 "to reach a temperature of 77 K"; H2 charged 5 min at stable pressure, cell isolated and the H2 discharging volume V1 measured; capacity from a corrected volume Vcorr accounting for compressed gas in the cell (empty-cell volume of compressed gas determined at every pressure by the adsorption procedure) and the real volume of the sample (real density d = 2 g cm-3, cited from ref. [14]; stored as skeletal_density_g_cm3, not measured). Coded volumetric_sieverts (gas-volume method); basis not named (no excess/absolute/total wording), basis_inferred excess by the volumetric instrumental default. isotherm_branch adsorption: equilibrium after charging; the amount is quantified from the discharged volume, not a desorption branch. H2 instrument not named and not described as home-built. sample_mass_mg from printed "1.5 g". Characterization: "TSA, total surface area" from N2 at 77 K (ASAP2000-micromeritics), method not named, stored in bet_surface_area_m2_g with surface_area_method unspecified; no BET range stated. Vt = total pore volume from N2 at P/P0 = 0.95; VDR(N2) = Dubinin-Radushkevich on N2 at P/P0 <= 0.1 (micropore_volume_cm3_g); VDR(CO2) = DR on CO2 at 273 K, P/P0 < 0.03 (micropore_volume_co2_cm3_g; text says CO2 at 273 K assesses pores smaller than 0.7 nm). replicates_reported true: Fig. 2 shows error bars on the 1 and 10 bar values of every sample (magnitude not printed, so uncertainty_wt_pct left empty). Value also plotted in Fig. 2(a) (main-3, H2 capacity vs TSA, 1 bar series; not an isotherm, not digitized).
free_volume_calibration: volume of compressed gas in the empty cell determined at every pressure following the adsorption procedure (H2, 77 K implied); sample volume from real density d = 2 g cm-3 [14]
